main_numerical_scope: Independent direct re-evaluation of five fixed complete searches or all screened candidates with independently recomputed screening and fit inputs; additionally all accepted events in all 100 exposures, plus combined counts and identity checks. Exact implemented coverage will be reported, not silently broadened in claims.
validation_numerical_scope: All 16 unique unmodified patches, 48 phase queries and 192 injected trials: compare saved backgrounds with corresponding FITS, independently compute injection profile/scaling and V2 profile fit quantities, verify acceptance and recovery matching, and cross-check V1 frozen results.

numeric_comparison_tolerances.near_threshold_review: Flag differences within numerical tolerance of a decision boundary explicitly; do not promote an arbitrary floating point difference into a generic failed science outcome.

metadata_scope: All 104 selected identities, target/start/ADP/raw-progenitor disjointness against original105 and each other, original quality criteria, metadata/header consistency, checksums, units/frame, intended-coordinate consistency. This is not a full independent astronomical source identification.
execution_gate: No new main or validation science arrays until parent root explicitly releases review after corresponding analysis is frozen/authorized.
